title: Replying to @Audi Videos I genuinely can’t believe this ended up bein...
transcript: Starlight Express is maybe the worst show I've ever seen but also I loved every minute of it and I would go back a million times 😅 This show is the very definition of just go for the vibes, because you certainly don't go for the plot which there is very little of and what little we do get makes no sense. And I would argue you shouldn't even go for the score, which is maybe Andrew Lloyd Webber's worst (which is saying something) The lyrics, which actually were not written by Andrew Lloyd Webber, are pretty abysmal and feature such gems like: “Just because I smile all the time, doesn't mean I'm not into crime” But the vibes are just chef's kiss 👌🏻 It is never not thrilling to see someone zoom past you on roller skates, and honestly the most fun I had was during the race sections of the show where we would cheer loudly as the train that we wanted to win rushed past us and then we would boo the evil trains as they passed us. And honestly even when they're not racing the entire show has this absurdity to it that is really unintentionally hilarious. Like for example, did you know that Starlight Express is actually Train God and towards the end of the show it is revealed that Rusty, our main character, is actually Train Jesus? Because I did not! And the cast and director absolutely understand the assignment and lean into the camp and absurdity of it all. The entire show feels like a fever dream, and honestly in that sense the fact that the show is so bad kind of enhances the experience. Like I don't know that I would actually want a Starlight Express that is competently written? Nor would I really wanna see a parsed down production! Like I am really glad that this production decided to go all out in its staging! Not only is the entire theater transformed into a multi-level roller rink, but also some truly stunning staging moments that I won't dare spoil but genuinely took my breath away! This was honestly one of my least anticipated shows of this trip, just because I am a certified Andrew Lloyd Webber hater™️, and honestly have never really liked a show of his… And while the show has not changed my opinion on him as a composer, I did really enjoy it! And if you go in with the proper expectations, I think you'll enjoy it too!
